# `oaap data`

managed Postgres, type registry and other data-platform services (oaap.data.store 0.1, oaap.data.model 0.1, RFC-0031).

**Root:** depends on the action -- see the table below.

## Usage

```sh
oaap data {store,model,twin} {status,schemas,create,copy,drop,restore,migrate-twin,close,types,show,register,alias,bindings,readers,add-reader,remove-reader} [arg1] [arg2] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `object` | (one of `store`, `model`, `twin`) |
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `arg1` | create: purpose; copy/drop: schema; restore: dump file; model show/register/alias: type key or definition file; model bindings: instance |
| `arg2` | create: tenant-id; copy: new schema name; model alias: the alias word |
| `--yes` | drop: confirm — deletes the schema permanently |
| `--quiet` | migrate-twin: say nothing unless a schema was actually migrated (migrate.sh) |
| `--tenant TENANT` | model types/register: tenant-id (RFC-0031 §4 third origin — the twin browser's CLI stand-in); twin add-reader: the tenant it reads |
| `--reads READS` | twin add-reader: the type keys it may read, comma-separated (oaap.data.twin 2.14) |
| `--days DAYS` | twin add-reader: key validity in days (default 90, max 365) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `status` | no |
| `schemas` | no |
| `create` | yes |
| `copy` | yes |
| `drop` | yes |
| `restore` | yes |
| `migrate-twin` | yes |
| `close` | yes |
| `types` | no |
| `show` | no |
| `register` | yes |
| `alias` | yes |
| `bindings` | no |
| `readers` | no |
| `add-reader` | yes |
| `remove-reader` | yes |
